artifacts_reviewed.description: The sole EHI export documentation artifact: a 6-page PDF created by printing an internal documentation page to PDF via Chrome. Contains annotated screenshots walking through the single-patient and multi-patient export process. Shows the export UI, NDJSON file listing, and patient document folder structure. No data dictionary, schema, or field-level documentation.
The registered CHPL URL page. A minimal ASP.NET page that embeds EHI_Document.pdf via an iframe. This is the wrapper page, not the documentation itself.

The HTML source of the EHI Document page referenced in the PDF footer. Contains the same content as the PDF (screenshots and instructions) in its original HTML form. This is the page that was printed to PDF to create EHI_Document.pdf.

analysis_notes.no_data_dictionary: No data dictionary, schema, or field-level documentation exists. The only artifact is a screenshot-based PDF showing the export UI workflow.
analysis_notes.field_counts_from_spec: Field counts listed as 'fhir_r4_standard_fields' are from the FHIR R4 specification, NOT from vendor documentation. The vendor documents zero fields.
analysis_notes.non_us_core_resources: Invoice and Appointment are NOT US Core resources, suggesting slight vendor extension beyond standard (g)(10) FHIR API.
analysis_notes.missing_us_core_types: Several common US Core resource types are absent: AllergyIntolerance, Immunization, Procedure, DiagnosticReport, CarePlan, Goal, Device, Location, MedicationAdministration.
analysis_notes.documents_included: The export includes a Documents/ subfolder with actual patient files (PDFs, images), which goes beyond standard FHIR export.
